# Game Reflection

Use one half of film from your game. Make a mark in the tally column each time you see the action, and add a short note when a clip teaches you something. The [Film Review Guide](../film-review-guide.md#simple-game-tally) explains each step.

| Game | Date | Position |
|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |

## Simple game tally

| Action                                       | Tally                | Notes                          |
|----------------------------------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|
| Received the ball |  |  |
| Scanned before receiving |  |  |
| Received facing forward or on the half-turn |  |  |
| Broke a line with a pass or carry |  |  |
| Moved to a new angle after passing |  |  |
| Won or blocked the ball by reading the play |  |  |
| Asked for the ball |  |  |

A scan is a head turn away from the ball in the 5 seconds before your first touch. Skip clips where you cannot clearly see your head.

## Three-part self-review

| One thing I did well | One thing to improve | One solution to try |
|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |
|  |  |  |

Take your one solution into the next practice, then look for it again on the next film.

**Compare with your own last game, not with teammates.**
